fusions.name: Lulling Hum
fusions.desc: Sends a soft hum into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 water damage with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Easing Wash
fusions.desc: A wide cone of sound deals 26 water damage to everything in it. Your party deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Tide
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sinking Calm
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (21% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
